title: C0 - Founder console: truthful identity and state
outcome: The Founder lands as Andrew Hermann, owner, in this installation: the identity and a Steel Mission organization are seeded into the runtime state directory through the existing config-seeding seam, never into the shipped tree. The console then shows the true capability state: owner and admin derive their Domain Capabilities from the workspace grant rather than from the raw per-user assignment field that is empty for them by design, so the Founder sees all thirteen instead of an empty-state message. A declared identity that resolves to no registered user falls back the same way a missing one does instead of producing a capability-less actor. The sidebar reports real server and authority state from the health and control-plane readiness endpoints, and a provider status strip shows, per provider, connected, online, idle or working, with token usage where the provider reports it.
notInScope: The shipped Northstar Forge demo company and its users are untouched: the Founder identity lives in the installation's runtime state directory, never in config/ or starter-company/, and the org-data-boundary tests keep proving it. No login screen, no identity picker, no change to oidc-required behaviour. No chat surface - that is MS-0014. No new provider - that is MS-0015.
completionEvidence: A fresh incognito session against a clean checkout lands as Andrew Hermann, owner, with thirteen capabilities visible, demonstrated against the running server. The shipped fixture is byte-identical before and after, and the org-data-boundary tests pass. A request carrying a stale X-Present-Actor naming an unregistered user resolves to the registered owner rather than a ghost, asserted by a test watched to fail first. Stopping and starting the local model observably changes the status strip, and the sidebar no longer contains hardcoded state strings, proven by a test that greps the built page.

metadata.origin: Folded in at the D7 rescope of 2026-08-20. The founder-identity item was mistakenly trimmed the same day on a misread instruction and restored by the Founder's decision; the +1.8 focused-day delta is printed on the project record.
metadata.risk: The identity fixes touch the authentication fallback path and carry a security review. The temptation is to special-case the owner in the page; the fix belongs where the truth already lives, in the workspace derivation the server ships.
